quests.title: Tea Party Re-Invitation: Tabletop Troupe

dialogue.t: What about you, Miss Sandrone? Did you enjoy playing Tabletop Troupe?

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Alright! Let's play again next time!

quests.description: Go to Chioriya Boutique, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests…
